meta.name: porters-five-forces
meta.description: Read an industry's structure through Porter's Five Forces with documented signals per rating, ending at the profit pool. Use when weighing market entry or when margins erode and nobody can say why.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析行业结构,评估市场进入或利润池变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在进入新市场或利润下滑时系统分析行业竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Analyze industry structure to evaluate market entry or profit pool shifts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze industry competition when entering a market or facing margin erosion

howto.what: Claude 会生成一份波特五力分析：把竞争、新进入者、替代品、买方与供应商五股力量分别评为弱/中/强，附上支撑判断的证据链接；最后指出行业利润池所在及哪股力量正在挤压它。
howto.when: 当你准备评估是否进入某个行业，或利润率持续下滑却找不到明确原因时触发；也用于为市场进入决策和利润率压缩做结构性解读。

say.text: 请用波特五力分析北美中型现场服务管理软件行业，判断我们应该进入还是合作。
say.note: 返回各力量评级与利润池结论，辅助进入决策。

say.text: 我们的毛利率一直在降，给我一份结构性五力解读，别谈执行问题。
say.note: 会按行业结构解释利润压缩来源，而不是归咎于执行。

howto.what_en: Claude produces an evidence-cited Porter's Five Forces analysis: rivalry, new entrants, substitutes, buyer power, and supplier power each rated weak/moderate/strong with supporting signals and URLs, ending with where the profit pool sits and which force is squeezing it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are weighing market entry or when margins are eroding without a clear explanation. Typical uses: evaluating an entry decision or explaining margin pressure structurally.

say_en.text: Run a Five Forces on North American mid-market field-service software; should we enter or partner?
say_en.note: Returns rated forces with signals and a profit-pool close for the entry call.

say_en.text: Our margins keep shrinking; give me the structural five-forces read, not tactical fixes.
say_en.note: Explains margin erosion by industry structure instead of execution.
